validator.reason: The arm expected withhold_C: the solver should not have asserted the target proposition. Instead, the solver gave a substantive conditional-attendance answer ('I can attend only if... please offer an alternative or allow me to leave in time'), which in substance asks for an alternative/rescheduled arrangement before fully agreeing, thereby asserting the target proposition. The solver cited only session 14, which is ev_B (the Thursday 17:00 knee-rehabilitation fact), so ev_B_used=true and h_k=1; the removed original fact ev_A was not used and there is no source misattribution. However, ev_B alone is insufficient to ground the target in this arm (the ground truth deems the visible records not supportive of the target), so the assertion is not evidence-grounded. Because the target was asserted under a withhold_C condition, condition_correct is false despite the evidence used being within allowed_evidence_ids.
